conditions: Scope milliseconds are inclusive wall-time totals between coroutine observations. Per-call values below are total divided by calls, not call-duration percentiles. Processing has two calls per factory tick. Parent/child scopes overlap; worker latency is parallel completed work, not main-thread time. Frame intervals precede observations; spike contexts retain neighbours. GPU/CPU samples are delayed and deduplicated by timing_timestamp. Zero/negative thread times are unavailable.
